findings.title: Reader thread not joined before asserting exceptions
findings.body: The test sets `deletedAll` and immediately asserts that `caughtExceptions` is empty. The reader thread is never joined, so a request that is still in flight, or an exception raised during the last iterations, is not observed. The test can pass even when the NPE still occurs. It can also leave a live thread running into later tests. Keep a reference to the thread and `join()` it before the assertion.

findings.title: Other subgroup methods still NPE when group is deleted concurrently
findings.body: The fix null-guards only `getSubGroupsCount`. The `getSubGroupsStream(...)` overloads at lines 256, 262 and 268 still dereference `modelSupplier.get()` without a check. If the group is deleted concurrently, these overloads hit the same NPE this PR is meant to fix.

findings.title: getSubGroupsCount may now return null
findings.body: Callers such as `populateSubGroupCount` now receive a null count for a deleted group. Any caller that unboxes the `Long` (for example, comparing it with 0) will throw an NPE instead. Returning 0 would be safer, as would documenting that the method can return null.
